{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Senior Service Engineer",
  "description": "Husk is one of the world&rsquo;s leading rural energy providers. We provide low-cost and reliable power to rural households and businesses, entirely from renewable energy sources. Powering economic possibilities in every village is at the heart of everything we do.

We design, build and operate the lowest cost hybrid (solar and biomass) power plant and distribution network in India and Africa. To date, Husk has provided electricity to over 15,000 homes and business, reducing 95,000 tonnes of CO2. Our aim is to provide 30MW of power to 225,000 customers by 2025, and save 350,000 tonnes of CO2 each year.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Senior Service Engineer

Location: Lafia Road, Nasarawa

Job Description


	The C&amp;I Operations Engineer/Lead owns the full operational lifecycle of Husk&#39;s Commercial &amp; Industrial (C&amp;I) solar portfolio in Nigeria - from commissioning handover (HOTO) through day-to-day service delivery, maintenance execution, customer relationship management, and performance reporting.&nbsp;
	The role is the single operational accountability point for all active C&amp;I sites, ensuring asset uptime, contracted SLA fulfilment, and customer satisfaction are consistently achieved.&nbsp;
	This is a hands-on, field-anchored position requiring deep technical competence combined with the commercial maturity to manage high-value client relationships directly.&nbsp;
	As the C&amp;I portfolio scales, this role will anchor the foundation of Husk Nigeria&#39;s C&amp;I Operations function and is expected to evolve into a team leadership position.


Key Responsibilities
Asset Operations &amp; Uptime Management:


	Own the operational performance of all active C&amp;I sites - ensuring maximum plant availability and energy delivery in line with contracted SLAs.
	Monitor daily site performance data and act on anomalies proactively before customer escalation.
	Maintain accurate site logs, operational parameters, and energy flow records for each C&amp;I asset.


Preventive Maintenance (PM):


	Design and execute structured Preventive Maintenance programmes for all C&amp;I sites in accordance with OEM specifications, IEC standards, and Husk&#39;s Technical &amp; Operating Standards.
	Schedule and mobilise field technicians, third-party service vendors, and spare parts to execute PM on time and within budget.
	Maintain PM completion records, checklists, and compliance documentation for all sites.
	Conduct periodic site inspections to validate PM quality and identify emerging failure risks.


Corrective Maintenance (CM) &amp; Fault Resolution:


	Serve as the primary technical response owner for all unplanned faults, equipment failures, and site outages across the C&amp;I portfolio.
	Lead fault diagnosis, root-cause analysis, and resolution - hands-on where required, coordinating specialist support for complex faults.
	Manage escalation protocols: ensure critical faults are acknowledged within 1 hour and resolved within agreed MTTR targets.
	Track open corrective actions, prevent repeat failures, and close out tickets systematically through the maintenance management system.


Customer Relationship Management (Post-HOTO):


	Serve as the primary operational point of contact for all C&amp;I customers after commissioning handover - managing the day-to-day relationship with professionalism and responsiveness.
	Conduct regular service review meetings with clients; present performance reports, address concerns, and maintain trust throughout the PPA lifecycle.
	Manage customer complaints and service requests within defined SLAs - ensuring formal logging, root-cause communication, and satisfactory resolution.
	Proactively communicate planned maintenance schedules, outages, and system changes to affected customers in advance.
	Identify and escalate any commercial, contractual, or relationship risks to the Senior Director in a timely manner.


Reporting &amp; Performance Visibility:


	Prepare and submit weekly site performance reports and monthly Operations Summaries covering uptime, Solar generation, preventive/corrective maintenance status, usage and customer satisfaction.

Senior Service Engineer Job at Husk Power Energy Systems Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Husk is one of the world’s leading rural energy providers. We provide low-cost and reliable power to rural households and businesses, entirely from renewable energy sources. Powering economic possibilities in every village is at the heart of everything we do.

We design, build and operate the lowest cost hybrid (solar and biomass) power plant and distribution network in India and Africa. To date, Husk has provided electricity to over 15,000 homes and business, reducing 95,000 tonnes of CO2. Our aim is to provide 30MW of power to 225,000 customers by 2025, and save 350,000 tonnes of CO2 each year.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Service Engineer
     

            
    



Location: Lafia Road, Nasarawa

Job Description


	The C&I Operations Engineer/Lead owns the full operational lifecycle of Husk's Commercial & Industrial (C&I) solar portfolio in Nigeria - from commissioning handover (HOTO) through day-to-day service delivery, maintenance execution, customer relationship management, and performance reporting. 
	The role is the single operational accountability point for all active C&I sites, ensuring asset uptime, contracted SLA fulfilment, and customer satisfaction are consistently achieved. 
	This is a hands-on, field-anchored position requiring deep technical competence combined with the commercial maturity to manage high-value client relationships directly. 
	As the C&I portfolio scales, this role will anchor the foundation of Husk Nigeria's C&I Operations function and is expected to evolve into a team leadership position.


Key Responsibilities
Asset Operations & Uptime Management:


	Own the operational performance of all active C&I sites - ensuring maximum plant availability and energy delivery in line with contracted SLAs.
	Monitor daily site performance data and act on anomalies proactively before customer escalation.
	Maintain accurate site logs, operational parameters, and energy flow records for each C&I asset.


Preventive Maintenance (PM):


	Design and execute structured Preventive Maintenance programmes for all C&I sites in accordance with OEM specifications, IEC standards, and Husk's Technical & Operating Standards.
	Schedule and mobilise field technicians, third-party service vendors, and spare parts to execute PM on time and within budget.
	Maintain PM completion records, checklists, and compliance documentation for all sites.
	Conduct periodic site inspections to validate PM quality and identify emerging failure risks.


Corrective Maintenance (CM) & Fault Resolution:


	Serve as the primary technical response owner for all unplanned faults, equipment failures, and site outages across the C&I portfolio.
	Lead fault diagnosis, root-cause analysis, and resolution - hands-on where required, coordinating specialist support for complex faults.
	Manage escalation protocols: ensure critical faults are acknowledged within 1 hour and resolved within agreed MTTR targets.
	Track open corrective actions, prevent repeat failures, and close out tickets systematically through the maintenance management system.


Customer Relationship Management (Post-HOTO):


	Serve as the primary operational point of contact for all C&I customers after commissioning handover - managing the day-to-day relationship with professionalism and responsiveness.
	Conduct regular service review meetings with clients; present performance reports, address concerns, and maintain trust throughout the PPA lifecycle.
	Manage customer complaints and service requests within defined SLAs - ensuring formal logging, root-cause communication, and satisfactory resolution.
	Proactively communicate planned maintenance schedules, outages, and system changes to affected customers in advance.
	Identify and escalate any commercial, contractual, or relationship risks to the Senior Director in a timely manner.


Reporting & Performance Visibility:


	Prepare and submit weekly site performance reports and monthly Operations Summaries covering uptime, Solar generation, preventive/corrective maintenance status, usage and customer satisfaction.
	Contribute C&I operational data and narrative to the Operations Dashboard and Monthly Performance Reviews (MPR).
	Maintain accurate records of all service events, faults, vendor activities, and customer interactions.
	Flag performance risks and operational deviations proactively with recommended corrective actions.


Vendor & Contractor Management:


	Manage C&I-specific service vendors, OEM partners, and field contractors - tracking SLA compliance, mobilisation timelines, and quality of work.
	Validate vendor deliverables, certify work completion, and process invoices accurately and on schedule.
	Support procurement of spare parts, consumables, and specialist services in alignment with approved operational budgets.


HSE & Regulatory Compliance:


	Enforce HSE standards at all C&I sites - conducting safety inspections, ensuring compliance, and promoting a zero-incident culture.
	Maintain and update commissioning records, HOTO documentation, and regulatory compliance files for all active sites.


Commissioning Support & HOTO:


	Support the Projects team during the commissioning phase of new C&I installations — participating in testing, verification, and snag resolution.
	Own the formal HOTO process from Projects to Operations: validate completeness of commissioning documentation, site readiness, and client acceptance before assuming operational responsibility.
	Ensure all new sites are fully onboarded into the operational management system at HOTO — with monitoring connectivity, PM schedules, and vendor coverage confirmed.


Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
	Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in operations, maintenance, or technical service delivery for large-scale solar PV, hybrid energy, or C&I power systems.
	COREN registration (or active pursuit) is an advantage.
	Relevant technical certifications in large solar PV systems, battery storage are a strong plus.
	Demonstrated experience managing O&M for installations of >200 kWp capacity, including corrective and preventive maintenance execution.
	Proven ability to manage multiple sites simultaneously, with accountability for uptime, SLAs, and client satisfaction.
	Experience managing service vendors, field technicians, and third-party contractors.
	Prior exposure to BESS (Battery Energy Storage Systems) and AC-coupled hybrid configurations is preferred. Strong working knowledge of solar PV systems, BESS, hybrid inverters, AC/DC distribution, and protection systems.
	Proficiency in reading and interpreting single-line diagrams, protection coordination schemes, and system performance data. Familiarity with energy monitoring platforms.
	Solid understanding of relevant standards: IEC 62446, IEEE 1547, ANSI relay codes, and Nigeria electrical safety regulations.
	Hands-on, self-starting operator who can diagnose and resolve faults independently - without waiting for direction.
	Strong customer-facing presence: professional, calm under pressure, and capable of managing high-value client relationships.
	Structured thinker who reports with clarity, escalates with precision, and documents thoroughly.


Compensation
N800,000 - N1,000,000 monthly.

HR Manager Job at HR Leverage Africa




        
    

        
        HR Leverage Africa is a leading Human Resources consulting firm dedicated to providing innovative and practical solutions to businesses across Africa. With a strong presence in several African countries and head quarters located in Lagos, Nigeria, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to optimize their human capital and drive business growth.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: HR Manager
Job Location: Ogba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	HRLeverage Africa is recruiting on behalf of a reputable Audit Firm for the position of HR Manager.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing the firm's human resource operations, driving people management initiatives, ensuring compliance with labour laws and HR best practices, and supporting the achievement of the firm's strategic objectives.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop, implement, and review HR policies and procedures in line with organisational goals and regulatory requirements.
	Manage end-to-end recruitment, onboarding, and employee confirmation processes.
	Oversee performance management, employee engagement, disciplinary procedures, and grievance resolution.
	Ensure compliance with Nigerian labour laws and HR best practices.
	Coordinate learning and development initiatives to enhance employee performance and professional growth.
	Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation.
	Administer compensation, benefits, leave management, and other HR operations.
	Provide HR advisory support to management on employee relations and organisational development.
	Foster a positive workplace culture that promotes productivity, professionalism, and collaboration.
	Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and take initiative in implementing practical solutions.


Requirements


	B.Sc. Degree / HND in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 3–5 years of relevant HR experience.
	Must be a registered member of the Chartered Institute of Personnel Management (CIPM).
	Experience in a professional services environment (e.g., audit, consulting, legal, or financial services) is an added advantage.
	Strong knowledge of Nigerian labour laws and HR best practices.
	Excellent leadership, communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to work independently, take initiative, and manage multiple priorities.
	Candidates residing in Ogba or nearby areas are strongly encouraged to apply.
	Must be available to resume within 2 weeks to 1 month.


Salary
N250,000 per month

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the  Job Position a as the subject of the email.
